newsitem.title: UK: Copper slumps to near $1,900 in LME evening trade.
newsitem.headline: Copper slumps to near $1,900 in LME evening trade.

text.p: Copper prices backpedalled during Wednesday evening inter-office LME trading, as the market geared up for a substantial test of the $1,900 level, traders said.
The softer trend followed on from patterns established during the rings, when the market was again rebuffed by the resistance that lurks just above $1,950.
Prices are now at their lowest for a week, and ongoing declines in warehouse inventories are doing little to foster upside sentiment, they said.
At 1800 gmt, three months copper was indicated at $1,900/1,903 a tonne, against $1,913 last on the kerb and the Tuesday close of $1,945.
